contribution_requirements: NO RED anywhere on this page (owner constraint; design-tokens.md + owner-constraints.md). Severity ramp walks dark green #1a3a2a -> satisfactory #3da35a -> lime #d1f470 -> poor #e8c547 -> worst #c98a2e; color is never the sole carrier. LEGAL: Google Maps Platform attribution/logo/legal AND Place Photo author attributions are MANDATORY under Google ToS and MUST remain visible and legible. NO CSS may target .gm-style-cc, a[href*="google"], or img[alt="Google"]; every overlay stays INSET from the map's bottom corners where Google paints its logo/legal. Match homepage design tokens: Inter, lime #d1f470 fill + #1a3a2a type, control borders #1a3a2a (not lime), hairline #e5e7eb, radii {14px panels, 999px/50px pills+CTAs, 10/12px fields}, hover shadow 0 4px 12px rgba(26,58,42,.12), focus ring outline:3px solid #1a3a2a.
key_patterns: VayuLokLive.tsx (~2589 lines) is ONE self-styled component, styled-jsx under .vl-live-. CRITICAL styled-jsx gotcha: styled-jsx only attaches its scope class to markup it can statically SEE in the return tree - keep ALL markup INLINE; lifting into a variable/child silently drops styles. Site lime token: --lime:#d1f470 (defined ~line 2180; also --lime-tint rgba(209,244,112,.22), --green #1a3a2a). HEATMAP (req 05): useEffect ~1200-1221 creates a google.maps.ImageMapType ONLY on layer-button click (never on load), tileSize 256, getTileUrl -> airquality.googleapis.com/.../mapTypes/{UAQI_RED_GREEN|PM25_INDIGO_PERSIAN}/heatmapTiles/..., pushed to map.overlayMapTypes. Tiles are server-rendered rasters with baked colormaps - lime must be achieved client-side (see RESEARCH-05 file: chosen Option B = CSS filter+blend+opacity on overlay tile s, scoped under the map canvas, reuse --lime). PHOTO ATTRIBUTION (req 06): captured at ~617, ~720, ~1361 (authorAttributions -> {name,uri}); 'clean' photos (attributions.length===0) are preferred for media; RENDERED to the user as .vl-live-photo-credit
